newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia to raise petrol prices by six percent.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia to raise petrol prices by six percent.

text.p: The Slovenian government said on Thursday it would raise prices of petrol by an average of six percent from Saturday on account of higher taxes on petrol.
It said the rise would bring in an additional 6.4 billion tolars ($40 million) to the state budget by the end of the year. The government has not yet determined the final budget for 1997.
The new price of a litre of unleaded petrol will be 90.9 tolars, up from 85.8 tolars.
Petrol prices were last raised at the end of March when they rose 9.5 percent. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439 ($ = 160 Slovenian Tolars)
